thesis: Collectors prove exposure. Detection use-cases prove the SOC would see exploit, post-exploit shell, and lateral movement toward NPI. They are not the same control.

detection.notes: patch-verify-bot inventories CVE-2024-0001 as kev_open. No SIEM rule attests an exploit attempt on rhb-az-jump-01.

use_cases.title: Post-exploit interactive shell on jump host

detection.notes: CIS snapshot exists for disk encryption drift. That is not a detection of a post-exploit shell.

use_cases.title: Lateral movement from jump host to NPI store

detection.notes: IAM graph and S3 CIS exist. No flow/EID correlation from rhb-az-jump-01 to rhb-prod-statements is attested.

use_cases.title: KEV aging past SLA on privilege path

detection.notes: patch-verify-bot flags kev_open. No SOC aging alert distinct from the vuln ticket is attested.
